svg.desc: Aditya presenting his projects with open arms. Featured: SupportDesk (Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis); Fraud Risk Pipeline (PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Python, SQL). More: ShopSphere E-Commerce, Finance Tracker, Word to PDF Converter, Car Price Predictor, HandsMen Threads CRM. Clickable links are below this image.
